run_chunk_scan_fwd: run the _chunk_scan_fwd Triton kernel to compute the forward pass of the SSD chunk scan operation
review_chunk_scan_fwd_kernel: review the _chunk_scan_fwd_kernel Triton JIT function that performs chunked SSM scanning with autotuned block configs
test_chunk_scan_fwd: test the _chunk_scan_fwd function with cb, x, dt, dA_cumsum, C, states, cu_chunk_seqlens, out, and seq_idx tensors
summarize_chunk_scan_fwd: summarize the _chunk_scan_fwd function that launches the SSD chunk scan kernel with optional D gate, z gate, and initial states
refactor_autotune_configs: refactor the @triton.autotune decorator configs to optimize block sizes and warp counts for varying chunk_size, hdim, dstate, and IS_CAUSAL parameters
